# Allowed gaps in the shipped dotfiles lock (home/dot_config/mise-dotfiles/mise.lock),
# read by check-lock.sh. Same format as lock-exceptions.txt (see there). Separate
# file because the repo lock's pipx exceptions would be stale here.
#
# Per platform on purpose: a `*` line could hide a platform with no release asset
# at all. scripts/check-lock-sync.sh separately requires an asset url on every
# locked platform for each tool installed via mise, so a gap listed here is only
# ever a missing checksum, never a missing asset (that goes in tools.yaml as
# native_on / missing_on).
#
# mise records a checksum only when the release publishes one (a checksum file or
# a GitHub asset digest); otherwise the lock keeps url/url_api, pinned to the
# release asset id, and `mise install --locked` still works.
aqua:PaulJuliusMartinez/jless macos-arm64  # release asset has no checksum file and no GitHub digest (jless 0.9.0 is old); lock holds url/url_api only
aqua:PaulJuliusMartinez/jless linux-x64  # same: no checksum file or GitHub digest upstream; lock holds url/url_api only
aqua:PaulJuliusMartinez/jless linux-arm64  # no linux-arm64 release asset; tools.yaml missing_on makes select-tools report it native there, and the pins skip it
aqua:denisidoro/navi linux-x64  # navi 2.24.0 assets have no checksum file or GitHub digest; lock holds url/url_api only
aqua:denisidoro/navi linux-arm64  # same: no checksum file or GitHub digest upstream; lock holds url/url_api only
aqua:denisidoro/navi macos-arm64  # no macOS release asset at all; navi is native_on darwin (brew), so the pins skip it there
aqua:aristocratos/btop macos-arm64  # no macOS release asset; btop is native_on darwin (brew), so the pins skip it there
